question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
-- Let me verify these numbers make sense
-- 2023 Red Bull: constructor 860 + best driver (Verstappen) 575 = 1435
-- 2022 Red Bull: constructor 759 + best driver 454 = 1213
-- 2019 Mercedes: constructor 739 + best driver 413 = 1152

-- Let me check the top 3
WITH last_race_per_year AS (
    SELECT r.year, MAX(cs.race_id) as last_race_id
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year
),
constructor_season AS (
    SELECT cs.constructor_id, r.year, cs.points as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN last_race_per_year lrp ON r.year = lrp.year AND cs.race_id = lrp.last_race_id
),
driver_season AS (
    SELECT ds.driver_id, r.year, ds.points as driver_points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN last_race_per_year lrp ON r.year = lrp.year AND ds.race_id = lrp.last_race_id
),
driver_constructor AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT year, driver_id, constructor_id
    FROM drives
),
best_driver_per_constructor AS (
    SELECT dc.year, dc.constructor_id, ds.driver_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dc.year, dc.constructor_id ORDER BY ds.driver_points DESC) as rn
    FROM driver_constructor dc
    JOIN driver_season ds ON dc.driver_id = ds.driver_id AND dc.year = ds.year
)
SELECT c.name as constructor_name, bdc.year, 
       cs.constructor_points + bdc.driver_points as combined_points,
       cs.constructor_points, bdc.driver_points
FROM best_driver_per_constructor bdc
JOIN constructor_season cs ON bdc.year = cs.year AND bdc.constructor_id = cs.constructor_id
JOIN constructors c ON bdc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE bdc.rn = 1
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3

-- Verify 2019 best driver for Mercedes
SELECT ds.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname, ds.points
FROM driver_standings ds
JOIN drivers d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
WHERE ds.race_id = 1030 AND ds.driver_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT driver_id FROM drives WHERE year = 2019 AND constructor_id = 131
)
ORDER BY ds.points DESC
